tldr: Jupiter in the 6th house: growth becomes personal through work, health, routines, service, maintenance, and stress.
body:
With Jupiter in the 6th house, this part of you expands through work, health, routines, service, maintenance, and stress. Jupiter describes growth, faith, appetite, opportunity, generosity, and the need for a wider view. In practice, this brings attention to the daily habits, tasks, workloads, and body signals that decide how sustainable life feels.

When this placement is supported, your days can become more honest, supportive, and manageable. Jupiter can become hope, confidence, perspective, generosity, and a larger sense of possibility.

When it is strained, stress can become normal simply because you have learned how to function through it. The harder pattern can show up as overextension, excess, overpromising, or assuming more is always better.
gift: hope, confidence, perspective, generosity, and a larger sense of possibility expressed through work, health, routines, service, maintenance, and stress.
challenge: overextension, excess, overpromising, or assuming more is always better around work, health, routines, service, maintenance, and stress.
